name: Aldebaran
tagline: The fiery eye of Taurus — an orange giant that may already host a giant planet.
history: Aldebaran — 'the follower' in Arabic, chasing the Pleiades across the sky — is a red-orange giant 44 times the Sun's diameter, though it only lines up with the Hyades cluster by chance (it lies less than half as far). Radial-velocity data suggest a multi-Jupiter planet in a 629-day orbit. The Moon regularly occults it, and every few years it blazes beside Venus in dawn skies — one of antiquity's four Royal Stars of Persia.
